verdict.rationale: Folk documents people and companies as record types with custom fields and person CRUD. Interactions can be captured by logging calls or meetings via MCP and by syncing Gmail conversations. However, no evidence shows contact-company linking or a per-record activity timeline view. missing for 10: documented person-to-company relationship linking, a per-record activity timeline (history of emails, meetings, notes, changes), company record management docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
